reason: platform: WebKit's Tab skips links by default (macOS "Tab to links" off) — the step expects a link focused; not a Rivet bug

harness: Playwright WebKit's synthetic mouse drag fires no dragend and the next click comes without pointerdown (pointer still down), so usePress ignores it (React Aria: a non-virtual click without a press) and the chevron step after the drag is lost; the drag steps themselves pass

Linux WebKit (CI runner) touch only: the first tap into the field / indicator / option is lost on a cold page (focus stays on body, popover or option press missing); passes on macOS WebKit touch and every Chromium cell. Seen in every CI run 2026-11-01..02. Needs a Linux WebKit repro (Playwright Docker image) of the loader's held touch press + focus replay
